project_structure:
HOCT/ (root)
├── models/ (model definitions)
│   ├── hoct.py (Higher-Order Cell Tracking Transformer core)
│   └── attention.py (Edge attention & geometric encoding)
├── data/ (data loading & augmentation)
│   ├── cell_tracking_dataset.py
│   └── transforms.py
├── utils/ (utilities)
│   ├── ilp_solver.py (ILP solver for tracklet inference)
│   ├── metrics.py (AOGM, Division F1, etc.)
│   └── geometry.py (segment distance calculations)
├── train.py (training loop)
├── evaluate.py (inference & evaluation)
├── config/ (experiment configs)
│   └── default.yaml
└── scripts/ (training & inference scripts)
    ├── run_train.sh
    └── run_eval.sh
architecture: Input (Cell detections + candidate edges) → Geometric Feature Encoder (RoPE + distance encoding) → Edge-Centric Transformer (Edge Self-Attention + Node Self-Attention) → Classification Head (Binary edge probability) → ILP Solver (Global tracklet optimization)

modules.name: Geometric Feature Encoder
modules.function: Encodes edge midpoints and geometric relationships using RoPE and line-to-line distance metrics

modules.name: Edge Attention Module
modules.function: Performs self-attention over edges, aggregating information based on geometric bias rather than topology

modules.name: Node Self-Attention
modules.function: Aggregates node features to resolve division entanglement in embedding space

modules.name: Classification Head
modules.function: Predicts binary probability of edge existence (link between cells)

modules.name: ILP Solver
modules.function: Converts predicted edge probabilities into globally consistent tracks respecting biological constraints (flow conservation, max one parent)
